SugarCraft\Input

EscapeDecoder final class

Terminal escape sequence decoder.

MethodSummary
__construct(?EscapeDecoderOptions $options = null)
decode(string $bytes): arrayDecode a byte buffer into zero or more Events.
remainder(): stringGet bytes that couldn't be consumed as part of a complete sequence.
drainedReplyCount(): intCount of unsolicited terminal replies drained into TerminalReplyEvent since the last reset() — the counters measure one decoder epoch, not a process lifetime. Distinguishes "recognized and drained" from the silent drops counted by droppedUnknownCount().
droppedUnknownCount(): intCount of complete-but-unrecognized sequences consumed with no event (unknown CSI finals, malformed runs, unknown Kitty key codes) since the last reset(); reset() clears it along with the state.
discardedPasteBytes(): intBytes of paste body swallowed past the 1 MiB cap while waiting for the paste's real 201~ terminator (the truncated PasteEvent announce fires once, at the cap). A forged paste that never sends the terminator keeps discarding — this counter grows monotonically and is the visible proof the tail became nothing rather than keys. reset() clears it along with the state.
flushDeferredEscape(): arrayResolve a lone trailing ESC deferred by the deferTrailingEscape option into the Escape key it (probably) was. Call from an application timer once no more input arrives within the escape-timeout window; if the buffered tail is exactly one ESC byte, clear it and return that KeyEvent. A held lone ESC P (no > followed) resolves the same way, to Alt+P.
reset(): voidClear the partial-sequence buffer, paste/string state, overflow-discard states, and reply counters. This is the host's recovery lever for a forged paste whose 201~ terminator never arrives (the decoder otherwise keeps discarding, by design, so no attacker byte can become a key).

KeyModifier final class

Modifier key flags for keyboard and mouse events.

MethodSummary
static none(): selfNo modifiers held.
static alt(): selfAlt modifier.
static ctrl(): selfCtrl modifier.
static shift(): selfShift modifier.
static altShift(): selfAlt+Shift modifiers.
static ctrlShift(): selfCtrl+Shift modifiers.
static altCtrl(): selfAlt+Ctrl modifiers.
static shiftAltCtrl(): selfShift+Alt+Ctrl — the bits the legacy CSI wire forms can express.
static all(): self
static fromMask(int $mask): selfRebuild an instance from a stored mask value (the IPC/bridge seam for hosts that persisted value()). Refuses anything outside the defined bit union — a phantom bit fails fast at the boundary instead of travelling silently through the event stream.
static fromKittyInt(int $raw): selfBuild a modifier mask from a raw Kitty modifier bitmask (bits already de-based by the caller: the wire field is 1 + mask). Bit layout per the Kitty keyboard protocol: bit 0=Shift, bit 1=Alt, bit 2=Control, bit 3=Super, bit 4=Hyper, bit 5=Meta, bit 6=CapsLock, bit 7=NumLock.
static fromSgrMouse(int $raw): selfBuild a modifier mask from an SGR mouse modifier field. SGR uses: bit 0=Shift, bit 1=Alt, bit 2=Ctrl.
static fromXtermParam(int $xtermParam): selfBuild a modifier mask from an xterm modified-key parameter.
includes(int $flag): boolCheck if a specific modifier flag is set.
value(): intGet the raw bitmask value.
equals(self $other): bool

StreamInputDriver final class

InputDriver backed by a PHP stream resource (e.g. STDIN).

MethodSummary
__construct(private readonly mixed $stream, ?EscapeDecoderOptions $options = null)
__destruct()
escapeDecoder(): EscapeDecoderThe decoder instance behind this driver — the seam for hosts that need reset() after a forged unterminated paste, flushDeferredEscape() on an input-idle timer (with deferTrailingEscape), or the drop/drain counters.
isEof(): boolTrue once the stream has reached end-of-file AND every buffered and remainder event has been handed out.
hasPending(): boolTrue when more events are already decoded and waiting (driver buffer or decoder remainder) — distinguishes "keep pulling" from a true idle.
read(): Event|nullRead the next Event from the stream, or null when the non-blocking read found no data (also returned forever after EOF once buffers are drained).

KeyEvent final readonly class

A keyboard event — plain key or escape sequence decoded key.

MethodSummary
__construct(public string $key, public KeyModifier $modifiers, public string $raw, public bool $isRepeat = false)
isRelease(): boolTrue when this is a key RELEASE event: the name is the "Release" prefix followed by the press name with its first letter capitalised ("ReleaseA", "ReleaseArrowUp"). Only the Kitty protocol can report releases, so this is false for every other source.
static plain(string $char, ?KeyModifier $modifiers = null): selfA bare printable key: the character IS the event, so $raw defaults to $char and a null $modifiers means "no modifiers held" (KeyModifier::none() — PHP cannot default a parameter to a method call, hence the nullable).
static esc(string $key, ?KeyModifier $modifiers = null, string $raw = ''): selfA named key (ArrowUp, Enter, F5, ...). Null $modifiers means none held; empty $raw falls back to the bare ESC byte, which is honest only for Escape itself — callers with real wire bytes should pass them.
